editorial.blurb: Afghan House serves authentic, fragrant Central Asian cuisine with the warmth of a family-run gem where every dish feels like a labor of love.
editorial.insiderTip: Ask the husband-and-wife owners for their recommendations—they'll guide you to standout dishes like the Uzbeki palaw and kabuli pulao, and arrive hungry because portions are generous.

topDishes.note: Fragrant saffron rice with cardamom, browned carrots, and raisins—a showstopper
Tender, well-seasoned, and absolutely the best according to regulars
Authentic, fragrant, and highly recommended by those seeking true Afghan flavors
